name: pinvou3-app
description: 品悟智能助手桌面应用

scripts.lint:ui: eslint src/main.jsx src/pet-main.jsx src/pet-menu-main.js src/components src/features src/hooks src/shared
scripts.prebuild:nsis: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/prepare-windows-runtimes.ps1 && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/clean-nsis-staging.ps1
scripts.build:nsis:stage: npm run prebuild:nsis && node scripts/tauri-build-with-secrets.js build --features dev-tools --no-bundle && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/stage-windows-nsis-resources.ps1
scripts.bundle:nsis: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/stage-windows-nsis-resources.ps1 -ValidateOnly && tauri bundle --features dev-tools --bundles nsis --config src-tauri/target/release/nsis-stage/tauri.nsis-stage.conf.json
scripts.test: npm run test:update-notice && npm run test:marketplace-oauth && npm run test:composer-tools && npm run test:voice-input && npm run test:scheduled && npm run test:builtin-secrets && npm run test:pet-animation && npm run test:pet-registry && npm run test:pet-active && npm run test:pet-selector-contract && npm run test:pet-state && npm run test:pet-card-state && npm run test:pet-reply && npm run test:pet-scheduled-notice && npm run test:pet-interaction && npm run test:pet-navigation && npm run test:pet-bootstrap && npm run validate:pet-assets
